author: Motokoka
scope: Visible wing, body and tail ink boundaries from the selected museum model. Constant authored pigments, without copied photographic lighting.
method: Connected legible ink contours, simplified below one source pixel; inverse projection to the authored upper-wing surface using the local calibrated camera.

wingFinish.scope: Upper silver uses the original0.4 roughness factor; complete fixed upper tips beyond the aileron span end use an additional2.0 factor. Both visible tips are less glossy, with albedo/normal/metal/AO/geometry and red/ink finishes retained. Museum coating-response reconstruction,not original-aircraft paint specification. No photographic brightness/normal field.

lowerWingFinish.scope: Constant authored pigment for lower-wing top skin only;original rib/dust/noise masks,ORM and normal detail preserved. Separate material/base image excludes shared Fabric on upper-wing undersides,fuselage seam tapes and wheel covers. Museum appearance inference,not an established original-aircraft paint specification;no photographic RGB or shadow field.

finMarkScope: Only visible designation ink contours from the main museum image. Near-side strokes rectified onto the actual rudder skin in the declared reference pose; opposite side is an inferred readable counterpart. Unreadable strokes are not transcribed as verified service text. No photo colour or lighting copied.
bodyMarkScope: Visible serial and manufacturer-area ink boundaries from the selected museum photograph. Constant authored paint, no copied surface colour or illumination. Maker strokes are not transcribed as verified text. Opposite side is an inferred readable counterpart; the actual photographed side uses ray hits on the imported fuselage.

bodyExtraction.scope: Serial-region extraction; the former sparse maker extraction is superseded by makerExtraction.

wingExtraction.method: Re-rectified original four connected numeral outlines to the revised authored airfoil; roundel absolute centre retained separately.

serviceExtraction.method: Dark local contrast against an11-native-pixel median background,RGB maximum125; boundary-touching and<3px fragments excluded. Only contours are retained, not photograph colours or lighting.

geometryVisibilityFilter.scope: Only pixels whose actual first mesh hit is the fuselage are retained. Fillets, seams and other foreground geometry are excluded instead of being baked as pigment.

serviceExtraction.scope: Visible linework only; symbols are not transcribed as known text. Opposite-side counterparts and pigment values remain reconstruction choices.

bodyPigments.scope: Constant authored pigment values under the local reference study; no photograph lighting field is copied.
bodyPigments.upperFinishScope: Uniform upper-part author pigments fitted under the fixed local comparison rig; marks and other colour zones remain independent. No photographic shading field is copied.
bodyPigments.foreSilverScope: Constant authored slightly lighter fore-silver coating pigment. GreyupperhoodandallotherBasepixelsremain;roughness/metal/normal/AO/geometry/lightingunchanged. Silver0675improvescurrent77whole/fore metrics;Silver069doesnotimprovefurther. Museumappearanceinference,notoriginalalloy/paintmeasurement;no photographicRGBorilluminationfield.
bodyPigments.dorsalDomainScope: Complete symmetric upper-grey paint domain narrowed from0.125to0.100 of the existing surface coordinate. Same constant grey/silver pigments, marks and field amplitudes. Outsideband exact. No varnish, white stripe, photo lighting/normal field or geometry changes; local museum appearance inference.

makerExtraction.method: Local dark contrast>=6 against11px median background,maxRGB140,min3px,boundary components excluded; contours only,not photograph colour.

geometryVisibilityFilter.scope: Only pixels whose actual first mesh hit is the fuselage are retained. Fillets, seams and other foreground geometry are excluded instead of being baked as pigment.

makerExtraction.scope: Visible complete designation-area strokes and parentheses, without a semantic transcription. Opposite-side counterpart remains inferred.

wingPaint.scope: Original four authored numeral contours retained. Constant museum-appearance ink,4x coverage masks and linear-light sRGB compositing;matched roughness/metal edge coverage. No source-photo colour or lighting field is copied;paint identity is not factory-verified.

upperRoundels.scope: Boundary-only museum paint placement, inverse-projected onto actual70 wing. Independent authored pigment and original variation/roughness; no photographic RGB or illumination copied. Not factory circle dimensions.
upperRoundels.method: Threshold-sensitivity checked, largest connected red region; 180 boundary points per visible circle inverse-projected onto actual70 upper wing, ellipse fit in physical coating coordinates. Known authored current circle recovered to about 1mm radial RMS as method control.
upperRoundels.provenance: Private diagnostics392/393/394; reference source/author/license/SHA at document root.
